- PR #1104 "feat: adopt Effect for pure operations and retries" — head branch `feat/effect-pure-operations`, base `main`, state OPEN. Branch commits (oldest first): `05ee904` feat: add Effect foundation types, `9b75e2d` refactor: isolate Hevy retry policy, `e9ce8d8` feat: centralize pure read error classification, `580b0ac` feat: run read operations through Effect, `1073abb` feat: schedule client retries with Effect. This PR is the BOTTOM of the stack; its base stays `main`.
- PR #1105 "feat(hevy-client): add request-local retry schedule module" — head branch `test/request-local-retry-state`, head commit `fa3fc92`, base currently `main`. This PR must become the MIDDLE of the stack: its base must be changed to `feat/effect-pure-operations`.

   git log --oneline -3 origin/test/request-local-retry-state

      If rebase reports conflicts in files you did not author in this task (e.g. .changeset/*, packages/hevy-client/src/generated/**), STOP, run `git rebase --abort`, and report the conflicting paths — do not hand-resolve.
      On success: git push --force-with-lease origin test/request-local-retry-state
   b. git switch test/fetch-config-merge
      git rebase test/request-local-retry-state
      Same conflict rule: abort and report rather than hand-resolve.
      On success: git push --force-with-lease origin test/fetch-config-merge
   NEVER force-push to main. `--force-with-lease` is permitted ONLY on these two feature branches. Never modify, rebase, or push `main` itself.
3. Update the PR bases with gh (the only gh mutations in this task):

   gh pr edit 1109 --base test/request-local-retry-state

5. Confirm mergeability bottom-up and report the final table:
